scope: Display-only waterway label thinning; original USGS hydrography, county filter, popups and all operational workflows preserved.

cases: one normalized name across source segments
viewport clipping without joining disconnected paths
late/aborted queries and visible failure handling

observed: Friant 3D: duplicate San Joaquin River labels removed; San Joaquin River and Friant-Kern Canal appear once after source loading
Madera Canal uses another position when spacing permits; withheld near crowded operational markers
Source lines and dam symbol remain available; 2D mode and resize transitions remain usable

limitations: Labels use loaded source features; names can be omitted while USGS tiles load, at map edges or where spacing cannot be maintained.
Screen-space sampling is a presentation optimization, not geometry simplification or hydrological aggregation.
Publisher name variants are only normalized for whitespace and case; separate source line records remain intact.
